mechanism_raw_difference.note: retained as a MECHANISM diagnostic only. A large raw difference is not evidence that cross-model measurement explains the proxy's published failure, because within-cell Spearman is invariant to per-network offset and positive scaling. The primary endpoint is the concordance change.
